_readme: Business glossary for the Retail Data Foundation demo. 07_catalog.py creates the domain, then each term under it (idempotent via state/glossary_registry.json), then links each term to the cataloged assets named in 'links' (asset names are matched exactly after a scan). Plain words first: the glossary is what CLAIRE answers from.

domain.name: Retail Data Foundation
domain.description: A simulated multi-store retail business. Customers sign up on the web, in the mobile app or in a store, buy products, pay, visit stores and can hold a paid membership (Bronze, Silver, Gold). All data is synthetic. Goal: one trusted, real-time view of every customer and every sale: captured once, cleansed and de-duplicated, governed and explained, then activated in the CRM.

terms.name: Customer
terms.description: A person who signed up through any channel. One person can arrive as several source records; the golden record merges them.

terms.name: Golden Customer Record
terms.description: The single surviving, cleansed record per person (survivorship: complete address first, then the best data-quality score, then the earliest sign-up). Built by the mapping m_rdf_customer_golden.

terms.name: Data Quality Score
terms.description: Share of the four core rules a customer record passes: valid e-mail, valid phone, complete address, known membership tier. 1.0 = all pass.

terms.name: DQ Valid (clean-only gate)
terms.description: A customer record with a valid e-mail AND a valid phone. Only DQ-valid golden records are sent to the CRM; the rest wait in the review queue.

terms.name: Review Queue
terms.description: Golden records that failed the clean-only gate. They are kept, never dropped, so a data steward can fix them at the source.

terms.name: Data Quality Scorecard
terms.description: Pass rate per data-quality dimension (validity, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, integrity, accuracy) plus an overall row. Green at 99 % or more, amber at 90 % or more, else red.

terms.name: Membership
terms.description: A paid monthly plan: Bronze, Silver or Gold. The tier sets the discount on orders.

terms.name: Order
terms.description: A purchase in a store, on the web or in the app, with one or more order lines. Amount = list amount minus discount.

terms.name: Payment
terms.description: Money received for an order or a membership. Status settled, failed or refunded.

terms.name: Store Visit
terms.description: A customer checking in to a store; dwell minutes run until check-out.

terms.name: Store Daily Sales
terms.description: Order lines, units and revenue per store and day.

terms.name: Change Data Capture (CDC)
terms.description: Every insert, update and delete in the operational database replicated to the warehouse within seconds by IDMC Database Ingestion.

terms.name: Reverse ETL
terms.description: Sending governed warehouse data back to operational systems: golden records to the CRM and to the operational database.

terms.name: Personal Data (PII)
terms.description: Name, e-mail, phone and address of a customer. Classified automatically by the catalog scan; restricted to roles that need it.
